name: LaserPecker LP1 Plus

tldr: LaserPecker LP1 Plus sits between LP1 Pro and LP2 in the pocket line : still ultra-compact, app-first, for jewelry-scale and travel engraving rather than sheet goods.

editorialDepth.advantages: LaserPecker LP1 Plus 5W suits makers who sell marks, photos, and gifts more than daily panel cutting. Reasonable open-frame entry price.
editorialDepth.limitations: Skip if you already quote 4 mm+ cutting in production. Not for cast acrylic or bare metal without spray.
